shared: All three bind Rats into a touching line where position decides what each unit gets.
differ: What travels along the line: chain-reaction triggers, shrinking stat gains, or shared damage in fights.

takes.label: The lit fuse
takes.line: Rats store Gossip pips and Blurt at three, setting off chain reactions; the Rat King fires every unit each turn.
takes.look_if: chain-reaction combos and a spend-or-hold choice each turn.

takes.label: Ripples that halve
takes.line: Each stat gain spreads along the Knot, halving per step, so placement is the puzzle; We, the Rattenkönig stops the halving.
takes.look_if: a placement puzzle that also rewards mixing in other tribes.

takes.label: One body, shared wounds
takes.line: Tied Rats split every hit across the Knot, so fights turn on shared damage; the Thirty-Two gives everyone one Health pool.
takes.look_if: the fight itself to change, with hits shared across the board.
